raw.rationale: Corticosterone is a glucocorticoid/mineralocorticoid agonist with broad anti-proliferative and pro-apoptotic effects in lymphoid and some solid tumor lines, but at 2.5 µM for 5 days it is unlikely to show lineage-selective killing in PRISM; glucocorticoid receptor expression is widespread and lineage dependencies are not strong enough to produce selective mean log2FC ≤ -0.5 versus all other lineages. Published PRISM/CTRP data show few selective lineages for steroids, with breast and lung occasionally sensitive but not consistently selective.
